steps.title: Two paths
steps.text: The poem compares a person who follows God’s teaching with windblown chaff. The rooted tree pictures steady growth. Chaff pictures a life without lasting support.

steps.title: God stops the weapons of war
steps.text: The poem praises God in Zion and describes warriors losing their strength. Divine judgment protects the afflicted while ending the confidence of armed power.

steps.title: Let everything with breath praise
steps.text: The final poem calls for praise with horns, strings, drums, dance, and cymbals. The collection ends with a wide invitation rather than one person’s prayer.
